claims: The NASA Artemis II mission successfully launched on April 1, 2026, at 6:35 p.m. EDT from Kennedy Space Center, Florida.
The SLS rocket successfully propelled four astronauts into Earth orbit to begin a 10-day mission around the moon.
The Orion capsule is currently operating normally in orbit after passing initial checks.
Artemis II is the first crewed mission to the Moon since 1972.
The Artemis II launch time was 6:35 p.m. EDT, Wednesday, April 1, 2026.
The Artemis II launch location was Launch Pad 39B, Kennedy Space Center, Florida.
The Artemis II crew is Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Hammock Koch, and Jeremy Hansen.
The Artemis II mission had a successful liftoff with crew currently orbiting Earth.
The Artemis II crew is scheduled for a 10-day journey including a translunar injection burn to head toward the moon.
